explication: Buildah is a CLI and Go API for constructing OCI or Docker-format images, primarily by creating a working container, applying build instructions or direct edits, then committing the result. The README documents this user workflow and additional image/container operations; sampled source shows CLI initialization, build-stage execution, file-copy support, and container mount handling. Several command implementations and integrations were not sampled, so documented capabilities are included but uncertain implementation links are omitted or marked unverified.
